days.title: Meiringen Holmes History and Aare Gorge
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Sherlock Holmes Museum
stops.detail: The Sherlock Holmes Museum is one of the highlights, besides the bronze statue and the roaring Reichenbach Falls with the fateful battle site.

stops.name: Aare Gorge
stops.detail: Discover Meiringen-Hasliberg in the Bernese Oberland: The Aare Gorge, Reichenbach Falls, family-friendly ski area and magnificent hiking trails await you.

days.title: Exploration of Reichenbachtal and Rosenlaui
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Reichenbachtal
stops.detail: Easy, long ascent through Reichenbachtal up to Grosse Scheidegg at the foot of the mighty Wetterhorn cliffs.

stops.name: Rosenlaui Hotel
stops.detail: Hike past the nostalgic Rosenlaui Hotel and glacier gorge, enchanted by the Wetterhorn.

stops.name: Rosenlauischlucht (gorge)
stops.detail: Along the Lütschine up to Grindelwald, the glacier village at the foot of the majestic Eiger, Mönch & Jungfrau peaks, on over Grosse Scheidegg, past Rosenlauischlucht (gorge) and the Reichenbach Falls, where Sherlock Holmes fell to his death, to Meiringen.
